patient_reported.custom_symptoms: Experienced brief chest tightness after climbing stairs.

doctor_assessment.notes: 12-lead ECG normal rhythm. Blood pressure 122/78 mmHg. Normal heart sounds S1 S2. No signs of acute ischemic changes.
doctor_assessment.advice: Rest from heavy lifting for 5 days. Paracetamol 500mg SOS for strain pain. Regular brisk walking recommended.

patient_reported.custom_symptoms: Moderate fever with chills in the evening.

doctor_assessment.notes: Throat shows mild erythema. Lungs clear to auscultation. Temperature 100.2 F.
doctor_assessment.advice: Steam inhalation twice daily. Adequate oral hydration. Tab Paracetamol 650mg TDS for 3 days. Vitamin C supplementation.

patient_reported.custom_symptoms: Irritation in throat and coughing mainly at night.

doctor_assessment.notes: Pharyngeal mucosa mildly hyperemic. No tonsillar exudates. Chest bilaterally clear.
doctor_assessment.advice: Warm saline gargles thrice daily. Tab Levocetirizine 5mg at bedtime for 5 days. Avoid cold beverages and dusty environments.

doctor_assessment.notes: ECG within normal limits. Prescribed rest and sublingual nitrates if discomfort recurs.
doctor_assessment.advice: Follow up in 2 weeks. Low sodium diet and 30 min daily walking.
